The Siege of Praag

For long months Praag has endured plague, starvation and the ceaseless attentions of the Northmen. Engra Deathsword has tired of watching the city die by inches. Now the walls must break, the streets must run red, and the Dark Gods shall have what remains.

Praag has endured long enough. Plague and starvation have weakened its people, yet still they cower behind their walls and defy the will of the Gods. Lead the final assault, shatter the city's defences and offer Praag to Chaos in blood and ruin.
The Siege of Praag
Praag has fallen. Its walls are broken, its defenders butchered and its streets run red with the blood of the vanquished.
The Siege of Praag

For months, Engra Deathsword has watched Praag wither behind its walls. Refugees crowd its streets, hunger gnaws at its people and pestilence festers within, while the servants of the Dark Gods harry those who still dare venture beyond the gates. Yet the city endures. Such defiance has amused Engra long enough. The time for starvation and sickness is over. Kholek Suneater marches with the host, and the warriors of Chaos gather beneath Praag's walls. By nightfall, the city shall stand no more.
